```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  message    = FALSE,
  fig.align  = "center",
  fig.crop   = FALSE,
  crop       = FALSE
)

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(gamlss)

fit                  <- params$fit
suite                <- params$suite
scored               <- params$scored
rank_table           <- params$rank_table
picked_name          <- params$picked_name
training             <- fit$training_data
scale_params         <- fit$scale_params
scaled_predictors    <- fit$scaled_predictors
piecewise_predictors <- fit$piecewise_predictors
linear_predictors    <- fit$linear_predictors
predictors           <- fit$predictors
has_scored           <- !is.null(scored)
has_suite            <- !is.null(suite) && length(suite) > 1L

invisible(stopifnot(inherits(fit, "calmer_fit")))

# Local null-coalesce + namespace-safe extractor (works under both
# devtools::load_all() and an installed CALMeR).
`%||%`             <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
extract_coef_table <- getNamespace("CALMeR")$.extract_coef_table
```

# Predictors

CALMeR conditions MAPQ on per-read / per-transcript features, joined into the
training set by `extract_features()` and pre-processed by `clean_features()`.
The model enters them in three classes (smoothed with `pb()`, piecewise linear
with a kink, or plain linear):

| Predictor | What it measures | How it's computed | Preprocessing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `n_isoforms` | Number of annotated isoforms of the gene that the read's target transcript belongs to. | `n_distinct(transcript_id)` per `gene_id` (GTF). | Lumped at 7. Enters as a piecewise linear basis with a knot at 5. |
| `tx_length` | Length of the target transcript in nucleotides. | Sum of exon widths per `transcript_id` (GTF). | Natural-log, then z-score. `pb()` smoother. |
| `gc_content` | GC composition of the target transcript. | `(G + C) / length` (FASTA). | Z-score. `pb()` smoother. |
| `pct_covered` | Fraction of the target transcript spanned by the read alignment. | `min(alignment_length / tx_length, 100)` (BAM CIGAR + GTF). | Winsorize 1st/99th, then z-score. `pb()` smoother. |
| `has_paralog` *(if present)* | Whether the target transcript has at least one qualifying cross-gene paralog. | minimap2 `asm20` self-alignment of the transcriptome; cross-gene hit with `alen ≥ 50` and `query_cov ≥ 70%`. | None (already a 0/1 indicator). Linear 1 df. |

# 1. Training summary

The picked model was fit on `r nrow(training)` reads sampled from primary
alignments. Predictors used: `r paste(predictors, collapse = ", ")`.

```{r training_predictor_ranges}
ranges <- lapply(predictors, function(p) {
  v <- training[[p]]
  if (is.logical(v)) {
    data.frame(
      predictor = p,
      min       = min(as.integer(v), na.rm = TRUE),
      median    = median(as.integer(v), na.rm = TRUE),
      max       = max(as.integer(v), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd        = sd(as.integer(v), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  } else {
    data.frame(
      predictor = p,
      min       = min(v, na.rm = TRUE),
      median    = median(v, na.rm = TRUE),
      max       = max(v, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd        = sd(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

knitr::kable(ranges, digits = 2,
             caption = "Predictor distributions on the training data (post-cleaning).")
```

```{r mapq_dist, fig.height = 3.5, fig.cap = "Observed MAPQ distribution on training data."}
ggplot(training, aes(x = MAPQ)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
  labs(x = "MAPQ", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 2. Model comparison

```{asis, echo = has_suite}
The suite of BEINF fits is summarised below. Models are ranked separately by
**AIC**, **BIC**, and **Nagelkerke pseudo-R²** (Cragg-Uhler); the rightmost
column is the average of those three ranks. The model with the smallest
average rank is highlighted as **picked**, and drives all subsequent
sections — residual diagnostics, partial effects, the forest plot, and the
scoring summary.
```

```{asis, echo = !has_suite}
Only a single fit was supplied to `calmer_report()`. The summary below
reflects that fit's AIC, BIC, and Nagelkerke pseudo-R². To compare against
alternative parameterisations, fit a `fit_beinf_suite()` and pass the suite
to `calmer_report()`.
```

```{r model_comparison_table}
if (!is.null(rank_table) && nrow(rank_table) > 0L) {
  show_tbl <- rank_table |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      AIC        = round(.data$AIC, 1),
      BIC        = round(.data$BIC, 1),
      df         = round(.data$df, 1),
      Nagelkerke = round(.data$Nagelkerke, 4),
      rank_AIC        = round(.data$rank_AIC, 1),
      rank_BIC        = round(.data$rank_BIC, 1),
      rank_Nagelkerke = round(.data$rank_Nagelkerke, 1),
      avg_rank        = round(.data$avg_rank, 2),
      Model           = ifelse(.data$picked,
                               paste0(.data$Model, " (picked)"),
                               .data$Model)
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$avg_rank) |>
    dplyr::select(-picked)
  knitr::kable(
    show_tbl,
    caption = paste("Model comparison. Lower AIC/BIC and higher Nagelkerke",
                    "pseudo-R² are better. `avg_rank` averages the three",
                    "per-metric ranks; the picked model has the smallest",
                    "average rank.")
  )
} else {
  # Single-fit fallback: just show this one model's metrics.
  rsq <- tryCatch(
    round(gamlss::Rsq(fit$fit, type = "Cragg Uhler"), 4),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  one <- data.frame(
    Model      = picked_name %||% "(supplied fit)",
    AIC        = round(stats::AIC(fit$fit), 1),
    BIC        = round(stats::BIC(fit$fit), 1),
    df         = round(fit$fit$df.fit, 1),
    Nagelkerke = rsq,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  knitr::kable(one, caption = "Fit metrics on the training data.")
}
```

```{r model_comparison_qq, eval = has_suite, fig.height = max(3, 3 * ceiling(length(suite) / 2)), fig.cap = "Standard-normal QQ plot of randomized quantile residuals on the training set, one panel per suite fit. The picked model is highlighted in the title."}
picked_lbl <- picked_name
qq_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(suite), function(nm) {
  f      <- suite[[nm]]
  rqr_in <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(qnorm(stats::residuals(f$fit, type = "quantile"))),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(f$training_data))
  )
  data.frame(
    model = if (!is.null(picked_lbl) && nm == picked_lbl)
              paste0(nm, " (picked)") else nm,
    rqr   = rqr_in
  )
})) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rqr))

if (nrow(qq_df) > 0L) {
  ggplot(qq_df, aes(sample = rqr)) +
    stat_qq(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, colour = "steelblue") +
    stat_qq_line(colour = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Theoretical N(0, 1) quantile",
         y = "Randomized quantile residual") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
}
```

# 3. Picked-model fit

```{r model_summary, results = "asis"}
cat("**Formulas used (picked model):**\n\n")
cat("- $\\mu$:    `",    deparse1(fit$formula$mu),    "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\sigma$: `", deparse1(fit$formula$sigma), "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\nu$:    `",    deparse1(fit$formula$nu),    "`\n", sep = "")
cat("- $\\tau$:   `",   deparse1(fit$formula$tau),   "`\n", sep = "")
```

```{r edf_table}
extract_edfs <- function(model, what) {
  smos <- tryCatch(
    lapply(seq_len(20), function(i) {
      x <- try(getSmo(model, what = what, which = i), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(x, "try-error")) NULL else x
    }),
    error = function(e) list()
  )
  smos <- Filter(Negate(is.null), smos)
  if (length(smos) == 0L) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    parameter = what,
    term      = vapply(smos, function(x) if (!is.null(x$name)) x$name else NA_character_, character(1)),
    edf       = vapply(smos, function(x) if (!is.null(x$edf))  x$edf  else NA_real_,      numeric(1))
  )
}

edf_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "mu"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "sigma"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "nu"),
  extract_edfs(fit$fit, "tau")
)

if (!is.null(edf_df) && nrow(edf_df) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(edf_df, digits = 2,
               caption = "Effective degrees of freedom for each smooth term in the picked model.")
}
```

# 4. Residual diagnostics

Randomized quantile residuals (RQR) should be approximately $N(0, 1)$ under a
correctly specified BEINF model.

```{r residuals_compute}
qr_train <- stats::residuals(fit$fit)
```

```{r qq_density, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Global QQ plot (left) and density vs N(0, 1) (right) for the picked model."}
qq_pts <- stats::qqnorm(qr_train, plot.it = FALSE)
qq_df  <- data.frame(theoretical = qq_pts$x, sample = qq_pts$y)

p_qq <- ggplot(qq_df, aes(x = theoretical, y = sample)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "RQR") +
  theme_minimal()

p_dens <- ggplot(data.frame(qr = qr_train), aes(x = qr)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "RQR", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

p_qq + p_dens
```

```{r resid_by_predictor, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "RQR density faceted by predictor bins, with N(0, 1) reference (red dashed)."}
make_rqr_facet <- function(predictor_name, n_bins = 5) {
  values <- training[[predictor_name]]
  # Treat logical and few-valued integer predictors as factors.
  if (is.logical(values) || length(unique(values)) <= 10L) {
    bin   <- factor(values)
    label <- predictor_name
  } else {
    qs    <- stats::quantile(values, seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1L),
                             na.rm = TRUE)
    bin   <- cut(values, breaks = unique(qs), include.lowest = TRUE, dig.lab = 4)
    label <- paste0(predictor_name, " (quantile bin)")
  }
  facet_df <- data.frame(qr = qr_train, bin = bin) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$bin))
  ggplot(facet_df, aes(x = qr)) +
    geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm, color = "red", linetype = "dashed",
                  linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ bin, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "RQR", y = "Density", title = label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
}

for (p in predictors) {
  print(make_rqr_facet(p))
}
```

# 5. Partial effects on E[MAPQ]

Each panel varies one predictor over its training range while holding the
others at their median (or `FALSE` for binary predictors), and shows the
model's expected MAPQ:

$$
E[Y] \;=\; \frac{\tau + \mu}{1 + \nu + \tau}, \qquad
E[\mathrm{MAPQ}] = 60 \cdot E[Y]
$$

```{r partial_effects_ey, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Partial effects on E[MAPQ] for the picked model. Lines for smoothed/piecewise predictors; columns for binary predictors."}
n_grid <- 200

make_base_nd <- function(n) {
  base <- data.frame(y = rep(stats::median(training$y, na.rm = TRUE), n))
  for (p in scaled_predictors) {
    base[[paste0(p, "_sc")]] <- rep(
      stats::median(training[[paste0(p, "_sc")]], na.rm = TRUE), n
    )
    base[[p]] <- rep(stats::median(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE), n)
  }
  for (p in names(piecewise_predictors)) {
    base[[p]] <- rep(stats::median(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE), n)
  }
  for (p in linear_predictors) {
    v <- training[[p]]
    base[[p]] <- if (is.logical(v)) rep(FALSE, n)
                 else rep(stats::median(v, na.rm = TRUE), n)
  }
  base
}

predict_ey <- function(nd) {
  mu_p  <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "mu",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  nu_p  <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "nu",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  tau_p <- stats::predict(fit$fit, newdata = nd, what = "tau",
                          type = "response", data = training)
  (tau_p + mu_p) / (1 + nu_p + tau_p) * 60
}

# Smoothed predictors: line plot over training range.
panel_scaled <- function(p) {
  nd     <- make_base_nd(n_grid)
  x_lo   <- min(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
  x_hi   <- max(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
  raw_seq <- seq(x_lo, x_hi, length.out = n_grid)
  nd[[paste0(p, "_sc")]] <-
    (raw_seq - scale_params[[p]]$center) / scale_params[[p]]$scale
  nd[[p]] <- raw_seq
  df <- data.frame(x = raw_seq, y = predict_ey(nd))
  ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.9) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 60)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
    labs(x = p, y = "E[MAPQ]", title = p) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
}

# Piecewise predictors: discrete line, one point per integer.
panel_piecewise <- function(p) {
  x_lo  <- min(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
  x_hi  <- max(training[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
  x_seq <- seq(floor(x_lo), ceiling(x_hi), by = 1)
  if (length(x_seq) > 12L) x_seq <- seq(x_lo, x_hi, length.out = 12)
  nd <- make_base_nd(length(x_seq))
  nd[[p]] <- x_seq
  df <- data.frame(x = x_seq, y = predict_ey(nd))
  ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1.6) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 60)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
    labs(x = p, y = "E[MAPQ]", title = p) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
}

# Linear (binary or otherwise) predictors: column for each level.
panel_linear <- function(p) {
  vals <- sort(unique(training[[p]]))
  nd   <- make_base_nd(length(vals))
  nd[[p]] <- vals
  df <- data.frame(
    x = if (is.logical(vals)) factor(vals, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))
        else factor(vals),
    y = predict_ey(nd)
  )
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.6) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 60)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60)) +
    labs(x = p, y = "E[MAPQ]", title = p) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
}

panels <- c(
  lapply(scaled_predictors,              panel_scaled),
  lapply(names(piecewise_predictors),    panel_piecewise),
  lapply(linear_predictors,              panel_linear)
)
patchwork::wrap_plots(panels, nrow = 1)
```

# 6. Coefficient forest plot

Wald 95% confidence intervals for the non-spline coefficients of the picked
model, one panel per BEINF distributional parameter (`mu` controls the mean
of the continuous part, `sigma` its dispersion, `nu` the zero-mass weight,
`tau` the one-mass weight). `pb()` smoother terms are excluded; their
contributions are summarised by the partial-effects plot above and the EDF
table.

```{r forest_plot, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Coefficient forest plot for the picked model. Vertical dashed line at 0; horizontal bars are 95% Wald CIs. Spline (pb) terms are not shown."}
coef_tbl <- tryCatch(extract_coef_table(fit$fit),
                     error = function(e) data.frame())
if (nrow(coef_tbl) > 0L && "is_pb" %in% names(coef_tbl)) {
  coef_tbl <- coef_tbl[!coef_tbl$is_pb, , drop = FALSE]
}

if (nrow(coef_tbl) > 0L) {
  coef_tbl$parameter <- factor(coef_tbl$parameter,
                               levels = c("mu", "sigma", "nu", "tau"))
  coef_tbl$term      <- factor(coef_tbl$term,
                               levels = rev(unique(coef_tbl$term)))
  ggplot(coef_tbl, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                   height = 0.2, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    labs(x = "Coefficient (95% Wald CI)", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
} else {
  cat("_Coefficient table not available for this fit (summary extraction failed)._\n")
}
```

```{r scoring_setup, eval = has_scored, include = FALSE}
flag_thresh   <- attr(scored, "flag_threshold")
filt_method   <- attr(scored, "filter_method")
threshold     <- attr(scored, "threshold")
dev_threshold <- attr(scored, "dev_threshold")
p0_threshold  <- attr(scored, "p0_threshold")
n_total       <- nrow(scored)
n_scored      <- sum(!is.na(scored$rqr))
n_flagged     <- sum(scored$flag_low %in% TRUE)
flag_src      <- if ("flag_source" %in% names(scored)) {
                   scored$flag_source
                 } else {
                   rep(NA_character_, nrow(scored))
                 }
n_flag_rqr    <- sum(flag_src == "rqr_low",     na.rm = TRUE)
n_flag_p0     <- sum(flag_src == "p0_dev_high", na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r scoring_header, eval = has_scored, results = "asis"}
cat("# 7. Scoring summary\n\n")
cat("Flagging is asymmetric across the MAPQ range:\n\n")
cat("- **MAPQ in (0, 60)**: RQR low-tail rule.\n")
cat("- **MAPQ = 0**: binomial deviance rule on the predicted zero-mass probability.\n")
cat("- **MAPQ = 60**: never flagged (max MAPQ cannot be 'unusually low').\n\n")
cat(sprintf("- Filter method:           **%s**\n", filt_method))
cat(sprintf("- RQR threshold:           **%g** (flag if RQR < %.3f)\n",
            threshold, flag_thresh))
if (!is.null(dev_threshold) && !is.null(p0_threshold)) {
  cat(sprintf("- MAPQ = 0 deviance cut:   sqrt(-2 log p_hat_0) > %.2f  (p_hat_0 < %.4g)\n",
              dev_threshold, p0_threshold))
}
cat(sprintf("- Reads scored:            %d / %d\n", n_scored, n_total))
cat(sprintf("- Reads flagged:           %d (%.2f%% of scored)\n",
            n_flagged, 100 * n_flagged / max(n_scored, 1)))
if ("flag_source" %in% names(scored)) {
  cat(sprintf("  - via RQR low-tail:       %d (%.2f%% of scored)\n",
              n_flag_rqr, 100 * n_flag_rqr / max(n_scored, 1)))
  cat(sprintf("  - via MAPQ = 0 deviance:  %d (%.2f%% of scored)\n",
              n_flag_p0,  100 * n_flag_p0  / max(n_scored, 1)))
}
```

```{r rqr_scored_density, eval = has_scored, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "RQR distribution on scored reads with flag threshold (red dashed)."}
ggplot(scored[!is.na(scored$rqr), ], aes(x = rqr)) +

```{r flags_by_niso_table, eval = has_scored}
has_src <- "flag_source" %in% names(scored)
flag_by_niso <- scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$n_isoforms) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_scored          = dplyr::n(),
    n_flagged         = sum(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE),
    pct_flagged       = round(100 * mean(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE), 2),
    n_flag_rqr        = if (has_src)
                          sum(.data$flag_source == "rqr_low") else NA_integer_,
    n_flag_p0         = if (has_src)
                          sum(.data$flag_source == "p0_dev_high") else NA_integer_,
    median_tx_length  = round(stats::median(.data$tx_length, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_gc_content = round(stats::median(.data$gc_content, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_has_paralog   = if ("has_paralog" %in% names(scored))
                          round(100 * mean(.data$has_paralog, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
                        else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(.data$n_isoforms)

knitr::kable(flag_by_niso,
  caption = paste("Per `n_isoforms`: scored count, total flagged, % flagged,",
                  "flags from each rule (n_flag_rqr = RQR low-tail on",
                  "MAPQ in 1..59; n_flag_p0 = deviance rule on MAPQ = 0),",
                  "and group-level context (median `tx_length` on log scale,",
                  "median `gc_content`, % of reads on transcripts with a",
                  "qualifying paralog)."))
```

```{r flags_dist_setup, eval = has_scored, include = FALSE}
# Distribution of flagged reads across predictor bins.
# Per panel, bars are stacked by flag source and the total height
# across all bins (for a given source) sums to 100% of that source's
# flagged reads.
scored_pred <- scored |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$rqr))
flagged_only <- scored_pred |> dplyr::filter(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE)

n_flag_rqr_total <- sum(flagged_only$flag_source == "rqr_low",     na.rm = TRUE)
n_flag_p0_total  <- sum(flagged_only$flag_source == "p0_dev_high", na.rm = TRUE)

# Bin builders.
gc_breaks <- seq(20, 80, by = 5)
gc_labels <- paste0(gc_breaks[-length(gc_breaks)], "-",
                    gc_breaks[-1])
scored_pred$gc_bin <- cut(scored_pred$gc_content,
                          breaks = gc_breaks,
                          labels = gc_labels,
                          include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)

# tx_length is log-scaled post-clean_features; bin in log space and label
# in raw (exp) values for legibility.
tx_breaks <- c(-Inf, log(250), log(500), log(1000),
               log(2000), log(5000), Inf)
tx_labels <- c("<250", "250-500", "500-1k", "1k-2k", "2k-5k", ">=5k")
scored_pred$tx_bin <- cut(scored_pred$tx_length,
                          breaks = tx_breaks,
                          labels = tx_labels,
                          include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)

pcov_breaks <- seq(0, 100, by = 10)
pcov_labels <- paste0(pcov_breaks[-length(pcov_breaks)], "-",
                      pcov_breaks[-1], "%")
scored_pred$pcov_bin <- cut(scored_pred$pct_covered,
                            breaks = pcov_breaks,
                            labels = pcov_labels,
                            include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)

scored_pred$niso_bin <- factor(scored_pred$n_isoforms)

has_paralog_col <- "has_paralog" %in% names(scored_pred)
if (has_paralog_col) {
  scored_pred$para_bin <- factor(scored_pred$has_paralog,
                                 levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                                 labels = c("no paralog", "paralog"))
}

summarise_dist <- function(df, bin_col) {
  df |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$flag_low %in% TRUE) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[bin_col]])) |>
    dplyr::count(bin = .data[[bin_col]], src = .data$flag_source) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pct = dplyr::case_when(
        src == "rqr_low"     ~ 100 * .data$n / max(n_flag_rqr_total, 1),
        src == "p0_dev_high" ~ 100 * .data$n / max(n_flag_p0_total,  1),
        TRUE                  ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
}

plot_dist <- function(tab, xlab) {
  if (nrow(tab) == 0L) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() +
           labs(title = xlab, subtitle = "no flagged reads in any bin"))
  }
  tab$src <- factor(tab$src,
                    levels = c("p0_dev_high", "rqr_low"),
                    labels = c("MAPQ = 0 deviance", "RQR low-tail (1..59)"))
  ggplot(tab, aes(x = .data$bin, y = .data$pct, fill = .data$src)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("MAPQ = 0 deviance"     = "#7B3294",
                                 "RQR low-tail (1..59)"  = "#D85A30"),
                      name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)),
                       labels = function(v) sprintf("%.1f%%", v)) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "% of flagged reads (per source)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r flags_by_predictor, eval = has_scored, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8, fig.cap = "Distribution of flagged reads across bins of each predictor, stacked by flag source. For each source, bar heights across all bins of a given panel sum to 100% of that source's flagged reads."}
panels <- list(
  plot_dist(summarise_dist(scored_pred, "niso_bin"), "n_isoforms"),
  plot_dist(summarise_dist(scored_pred, "tx_bin"),   "tx_length (bp)"),
  plot_dist(summarise_dist(scored_pred, "gc_bin"),   "gc_content (%)"),
  plot_dist(summarise_dist(scored_pred, "pcov_bin"), "pct_covered")
)
if (has_paralog_col) {
  panels <- c(panels,
              list(plot_dist(summarise_dist(scored_pred, "para_bin"),
                             "has_paralog")))
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 2) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
